_README: MANUAL CINC read of aeropeptides.com/products (Cloudflare-walled Store API; storefront read in-browser). Aero is adapter:cinc — refresh.py SKIPS it, so it is ingested via load_cinc.py from THIS fixture. Re-runnable: next weekend re-read the storefront in-browser, overwrite `products` below, and run `python3 load_cinc.py --vendor aero-peptides --write [--allow-shrink]`. Format per product: name (as the storefront shows it, size in the name for singles so parse_size gets it), size_mg (for reference/blend totals; null when the storefront doesn't publish one), price_usd, in_stock. Read 2026-08-17: 25 compounds, all in stock.
